tasks.label: docker-infra
tasks.detail: Start local infra (postgres, rabbitmq, redis, nginx) + Keycloak
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.overwrite.yml up -d && docker compose -f ../Dossier-Facile-Keycloak/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d

tasks.label: docker-infra-down
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down && docker compose -f ../Dossier-Facile-Keycloak/docker-compose.dev.yml down
